title: SITO: Sifting a Commercial Text-Safety API for Missed Harm and False Flags in English, Ukrainian and Surzhyk
abstract: arXiv:2610.27178v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Platforms that host young users screen messages with commercial text-safety APIs, but independent evidence on how often such systems miss harm or flag harmless text is scarce, especially outside English, and the documentation of the one studied here leaves its false-positive rate unquantified. We evaluated one such API, Tuteliq Detect as deployed under the release identifier tuteliq-detect-v5.20261011 (not the separately published v6 model), on six harm categories: authorised push-payment fraud, money-mule recruitment, social engineering, romance scams, gambling harm and bullying. We built SITO (Synthetic Independent Text-safety benchmark with Overflagging tests; sito is Ukrainian for 'sieve'), 2,332 synthetic cases in English, Ukrainian and mixed Ukrainian, with each harmful case matched by hard harmless ones: same-topic messages, minimal-edit contrasts, warnings and retrospective accounts. On English text the system flagged 84.9-94.1%

translated_title: SITO：对一款商用文本安全API进行筛检，发现其在英语、乌克兰语和苏尔日克语（俄乌混合语）中漏判的危害与误报
translated_abstract: 托管青少年用户的平台使用商用文本安全API来筛查消息，但关于此类系统漏判有害内容或误报无害文本的频率，独立的证据十分稀缺，尤其是在英语之外的语言中，而且本文所研究的这一系统的官方文档也未量化其误报率。我们评估了一款此类API，即以发布标识符 tuteliq-detect-v5.20261011 部署的 Tuteliq Detect（而非单独发布的 v6 模型），涵盖六类危害场景：授权推送支付诈骗、“钱骡”招募、社会工程攻击、浪漫诈骗、赌博危害和欺凌。我们构建了SITO（Synthetic Independent Text-safety benchmark with Overflagging tests，含过报测试的合成独立文本安全基准；sito在乌克兰语中意为“筛子”），包含2,332个英语、乌克兰语及乌克兰语混合语（苏尔日克语）的合成案例，其中每个有害案例都配有对应的困难无害案例：同主题消息、最小编辑对比、警告性内容以及回顾性叙述。在英语文本上，该系统标记了84.9%至94.1%……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了包含2,332个英语、乌克兰语及混合语合成案例的SITO基准，独立评估了一款商用文本安全API在六类危害场景中的漏判与误报表现，填补了英语之外语言环境下此类系统缺乏独立验证证据的空白。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SITO, a benchmark of 2,332 synthetic cases in English, Ukrainian, and Surzhyk, to independently evaluate a commercial text-safety API for missed harms and false flags across six harm categories, addressing the lack of independent evidence beyond English.
